exports.CURSOR_REFRESH_TOKEN_KEYS: exact state.vscdb keys for the refresh token
exports.normalizeCursorImportRefreshToken: (value) -> trimmed token or null; unwraps one JSON string level, rejects whitespace and >16 KiB
exports.readCursorRefreshTokenFromDb: (db) -> token or null; exact-key read on an open better-sqlite3 handle, never fuzzy
exports.findCursorAccountConnection: (connections, accountId) -> existing cursor oauth connection with matching accountId/userId, or null
exports.cursorImportConnectionValues: ({ tokenData, identity, refreshToken, now }) -> connection values for create/update

integrationSlots.slot: POST: accept optional body.refreshToken; build values with cursorImportConnectionValues; when it is non-null, update findCursorAccountConnection(...) with { replacesCredential: true } instead of creating a duplicate. GET: append CURSOR_IMPORT_REFRESH_FIELD.
readCursorLocalAuthSync: add refreshToken via readCursorRefreshTokenFromDb (changes the returned shape; update its callers and regression expectations in the auth batch).
Return the refresh token only to the dashboard import form, never in logs or error bodies.
